data.body: Next-batch internal records checkpoint. The user confirmed that code review is outside scope. The survey remains read-only and uses origin/main at fe62ecc69b901619b79eea7d54910f832e7d3937 because the shared worktree contains unrelated edits. Two narrow defects are confirmed. docs/maintenance-audit-runbook.md retains dated tool state and measurements, calls the absolute module-size ceiling soft, and contains stray capture tags. docs/architecture.md still presents the ADR 0100 CLI registry cutover as pending, although the route registry is now the sole authority and commit 21a178e27602c24ca78ccc2911608e9816f9780c completed the migration under ticket 69d3-3f7a-8deb-46fc. The ADR 0098 operation-composition subsection remains under verification. F01, rejected F02 through F04, deferred F05, and F06 through F07 remain excluded from this batch. No project file changed.
